title: Quote Git revision peel expressions in PowerShell
failure_signature: An unquoted commit peel expression produced a fatal single-revision error after other bounded checks passed.
trigger_preconditions: PowerShell passes a Git revision containing caret and brace syntax.
candidate_workaround: Wrap the complete revision peel expression in single quotes before passing it to git rev-parse.
recurrence_guard: Quote every revision expression containing caret, braces, colon, or shell-significant punctuation.
rollback: Retain the fatal probe and use the already attributable plain head only if the peeled form cannot be verified.
scope_boundary: Git argument quoting only; no repository mutation or authority credit.
